card.name: Linking words before drug or solution
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'in' or 'such' in dosing and preparation text, right before a drug, solution or combination is named. Also fires inside a few drug-class words and hyphenated terms.

modes.label: 'the' before solution or drug
modes.description: The word 'the' comes just before a named solution, drug or dose in administration instructions.
modes.example: during infusion of<< the>> solution containing CEFOTAN® (

modes.label: 'in' or 'such' before a combination or medium
modes.description: A linking word introduces a combination therapy or a diluent.
modes.example: may be required to reduce the risk of hypoglycemia when used<< in>> combination with TRIJARDY XR.

modes.label: Inside drug-class terms
modes.description: The pole fires inside or just after a drug-class word or hyphenated term, where 'containing' or similar could come next.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'composition' and 'compose', as in what a solution or product is made of.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a drug or solution is named, in dosing and preparation instructions.
